reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules and getRangeAmount, and folds getScheduledAmount onto the new helper, but adds a second exported amount function next to getScheduledAmount, which already decided the missing/number/range cases.

duplication.why: Removes four inline missing/number/range ternaries in favour of one helper; the remaining overlap is two exported functions (getPlannedAmount and getScheduledAmount) answering nearly the same question.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getRangeAmount and getScheduledAmount, where the tree keeps schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Touches only the amount call sites, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Single definition of the planned amount, but op is appended as a third positional parameter after the boolean inverse, forcing callers to pass a bare `false`, and some getScheduledAmount callers silently omit op.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Previously inline sites (schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedule-template.ts, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions) now call getPlannedAmount; getScheduledAmount delegates to it.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; getScheduledAmount wraps getPlannedAmount rather than re-implementing it.

one_place.where: getPlannedAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts holds the range and approx worst-case rules; getScheduledAmount and all server planning sites use it (display-only getScheduledAmount callers that omit op are not routed the op).
